role: Result-blind extension that adds the geometry-PCGLS and dual-ridge controls required by the C-route objective. It does not change v111 Stage A, the DRC-Warm model, any heldout roster, metric, threshold, or exact-call claim.

activation_gate.action_if_not_activated: do not fit or score these controls; retain the Stage A negative or cheap-control-dominance result

shared_evaluation_roster.outer_split: leave one complete PoolFire trajectory out
shared_evaluation_roster.candidate_reference: the same Zero-CGLS K2 accuracy and Zero-CGLS K4 harm references used by v111 Stage A

controls.definition: Build the exact geometry-only diag(A^T A), apply the frozen median-normalized inverse diagonal with a 1e-6 relative floor, and run zero-start PCGLS to K2.
cheap_or_setup_cost_reporting: exact and inverse diagonal persistent bytes
forbidden: relabeling identity PCGLS as geometry preconditioning
excluding setup from whole-pipeline resource reporting

controls.family: amplitude-equivariant linear-kernel ridge in detector-dual space
controls.definition: Within each outer fold and geometry, map sealed deployment observations to Zero-CGLS K4 detector-dual teachers using the donor's Euclidean-norm amplitude-equivariant normalization and fit trajectories plus fit maps only; lift the predicted dual once with exact A^T and run unchanged exact CGLS K1.

normalization.fit: divide each observation and its teacher dual by that observation's Euclidean L2 norm
normalization.prediction: divide the query observation by its Euclidean L2 norm and multiply the predicted normalized dual by the same query norm

controls.model_partition: one independently selected and fitted model per outer fold and geometry scenario

inner_selection.split: leave one of the four outer-fit trajectories out
inner_selection.objective: lexicographically minimize the maximum inner-trajectory-by-metric p90-higher, then maximum worst, then negative lambda so exact ties choose the larger lambda

resource_reporting: prediction plus exact K1 wall time
forbidden: outer heldout truth in lambda selection or fit
external RMS or second amplitude normalization

decision_rules.dominance: a control with no greater exact A and no greater exact A^T dominates one DRC seed only if the control passes the same trajectory gates, every trajectory-by-metric p50/p90-higher/worst component is no worse within 1e-12, and at least one is better by more than 1e-12
decision_rules.tail_noninferiority: for every trajectory, DRC-Warm p90-higher and worst must be no worse than each activated same-or-lower-call control for all four metrics
decision_rules.effect_of_any_failed_drc_seed: learned advantage fails under the parent all-seed rule
